# Source: ekb-flink-jobs/templates/taskmanager-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ekb-flink-jobs-taskmanager
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ekb-flink-jobs-taskmanager
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ekb-flink-jobs-taskmanager
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: taskmanager
          image: "ekb-mirror/yadea-ekb-flink-session:local"
          args: ["taskmanager"]
          env:
            - name: FLINK_PROPERTIES
              value: |
                jobmanager.rpc.address: ekb-flink-jobs-jobmanager
                taskmanager.numberOfTaskSlots: 8
                state.backend: rocksdb
                state.checkpoints.dir: s3a://ekb-lakehouse/checkpoints/
                state.savepoints.dir: s3a://ekb-lakehouse/savepoints/
                iceberg.catalog.type: nessie
                iceberg.catalog.uri: http://nessie.ekb-data.svc.cluster.local:19120/api/v1
                iceberg.catalog.ref: main
                iceberg.warehouse: s3a://ekb-lakehouse/warehouse
                iceberg.io-impl: org.apache.iceberg.hadoop.HadoopFileIO
                iceberg.lock-impl: org.apache.iceberg.aws.dynamodb.DynamoDbLockManager
                iceberg.lock.table: ekb-iceberg-locks
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: ekb-flink-dataplane-config
            - secretRef:
                name: ekb-flink-jobs-flink-runtime-secret
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "4"
              memory: 8Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 2Gi

# Source: ekb-flink-jobs/templates/batch-cronjob.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: ekb-flink-jobs-batch-quality-kpi
spec:
  schedule: "*/30 * * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: ekb-flink-jobs-flink-job
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: flink-runner
              image: "yadea-ekb-flink-jobs:0.1.0"
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - >
                  flink run
                  -m ekb-flink-jobs-jobmanager:8081
                  --detached
                  --savepointPath s3a://ekb-lakehouse/savepoints/ekb-quality-kpi/
                  --allowNonRestoredState
                  -Dexecution.checkpointing.mode=EXACTLY_ONCE
                  -Dstate.checkpoints.dir=s3a://ekb-lakehouse/checkpoints/
                  -Dstate.savepoints.dir=s3a://ekb-lakehouse/savepoints/
                  /opt/flink/jobs/ekb-quality-kpi.jar
                  --source-topic persistent://group/connectors/normalized
                  --sink-table ekb_gold_quality_kpi_daily
              envFrom:
                - configMapRef:
                    name: ekb-flink-dataplane-config
